review_records.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine

required_evidence: Confirm FSSR 2.10.9 and the actual dispensing/packaging condition, water quality criteria, legal contaminant standard and sampling.

review_records.forbidden_transfer: Dispensing purified water from a vending machine does not by itself establish that the marketed finished article is packaged drinking water.

required_evidence: Verify actual coffee-to-chicory proportion, product standard 2.10.4, finished-form contaminant article and test basis.

review_records.forbidden_transfer: FSSAI distinguishes dried or roasted chicory and coffee beans in individual metal source articles; a compounded coffee-chicory mixture must not automatically receive a single-ingredient limit.

required_evidence: Verify target age, full ingredient formula, special regulation and finished form

review_records.forbidden_transfer: Formulated supplements for children are not the same article as infant formula

proof_branches.branch: Frozen / cooked form is not original produce
required_evidence: Establish each actual fruit/vegetable commodity, processing treatment, composition, regulatory pesticide scope and an authorized processing factor before computing any finished-product residue conclusion.

review_records.forbidden_transfer: A raw-fruit MRL reference is not an automatic finished processed-food assessment for fried, frozen, cooked or mixed vegetables and pastes. For vegetable-only goods it is a negative comparison, not a candidate.

required_evidence: Identify botanical source, extraction, food grade and specified catechu product article

review_records.forbidden_transfer: Edible catechu is not a generic dye or tannic-acid purity material

proof_branches.branch: Fruit input does not prove finished fruit article
required_evidence: Confirm exact finished product (fruit pulp, fruit bar, preserve, candied peel, raw/dried fruit or mixed confection), the source article's processing scope and product-specific analytical matrix.

review_records.forbidden_transfer: Fruit ingredient content, fruit drying, added sugar or fruit peel does not on its own prove finished pulp/pulp product or untreated raw-fruit pesticide commodity identity.

proof_branches.branch: Coconut product is not milk or coconut oil
required_evidence: Determine the specific coconut product standard, processing and finished physical state; obtain a directly applicable coconut/non-dairy article before any numerical result.

review_records.forbidden_transfer: A coconut emulsion or powder is non-dairy. The metal article for 'Milks' is not an article for coconut milk; processing changes the raw coconut matrix.

proof_branches.branch: Cocoa beans, liquor and cocoa-sugar mixtures
required_evidence: Confirm whether the final tested food is cocoa powder, cocoa liquor, cake, beans or mixture and document the legally prescribed dry fat-free substance analytical basis.

review_records.forbidden_transfer: The official cocoa-powder Lead source uses a dry fat-free basis. Whole beans, cocoa mass/liquor, cocoa cake and mixed cocoa-sugar food are not automatically cocoa powder.
